about: Robin L. Harrison attended law school and graduated from The University of Michigan Law School in 1981. Robin Harrison began practicing law in 1981.
Robin Harrison is an attorney at Hicks Thomas LLP, helping people with Business Litigation issues. Hicks Thomas LLP has an office in Houston, Texas, serving the local community.

Robin Harrison was selected to Super Lawyers for 2004 - 2026. Super Lawyers is an exclusive list of top-rated attorneys in specific practice areas who were chosen after thorough evaluation of numerous criteria.

The Super Lawyers patented selection process is peer influenced and research driven, selecting the top 5% of attorneys to the Super Lawyers lists each year. We know lawyers and make it easy to connect with them.
